page: Amazon Web Services g7.8xlarge is a graphics-intensive virtual machine instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel processor running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. It is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For accelerated workloads, the g7.8xlarge includes a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 GPU equipped with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is provided by a 930 GB NVMe SSD, offering high-speed local read and write capabilities. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

The hardware configuration is optimized for graphics-heavy tasks, 3D rendering, and GPU-accelerated compute workloads. The lack of hyperthreading, with exactly 1.0 thread per physical core, ensures dedicated, predictable CPU performance per core, though it limits total concurrent thread execution compared to hyperthreaded architectures. This instance is suited for remote workstations, 3D visualization, and moderate machine learning inference workloads.
